Strategy: Refine the distribution-plus-worst-fit family with a count gate: an exact fit wins, otherwise use worst fit when at least four bins are feasible and Best Fit when fewer bins compete. The choice differs from Best Fit when many bins are open and no exact fit exists, since the loosest bin wins. Spreading across many bins may preserve tight bins, but worst-fitting with few bins would waste space, so the gate keeps Best Fit.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    n = len(bins)
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if n >= 4 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
